title: PhD in Economics and Finance
about: Bocconi University's four-year, English-taught PhD in Economics and Finance (EC-FIN) is accepting applications for the 2027-28 intake. The online application opened on 3 November 2026 and closes on 18 January 2027 at 23:59 CET; outcomes are expected by 15 March 2027.
requirements: Required degree must be awarded by 31 October 2027
